cases.name: testValueStatement
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    ev_result = VALUE #( ( a = 2
                           b = 4 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testValueStatementWithComment
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    ev_result = VALUE #( ( a = 1
                           b = 2 )
                         ( a = 2
                           b = 4 ) ). " comment
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testParameterList
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param_a = 1
                   iv_param_b = 2
                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param_a = 1
                   iv_param_b = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testParameterListWithComment
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 " comment
                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 ). " comment
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testParameterListWithConflictingComments
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 " comment
                 ). " conflicting comment
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 ). " comment; conflicting comment
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testParameterListWithCommentAndPseudoCommentUnchanged
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 " comment
                 ). "#EC NEEDED
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 ) " comment
                 . "#EC NEEDED
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testParameterListWithPseudoCommentAndCommentUnchanged
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 "#EC NEEDED
                 ). " comment
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    any_operation( iv_param = 1 ) "#EC NEEDED
                 . " comment
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testPragma
cases.exp:
any_method( EXPORTING iv_param1 = lv_value1
                IMPORTING ev_param2 = lv_param2 ) ##NEEDED.

cases.name: testPragmas
cases.exp:
any_method( EXPORTING iv_param1 = lv_value1
                IMPORTING ev_param2 = lv_param2 ) ##NEEDED ##OTHER_PRAGMA.

cases.name: testPragmaAndComment
cases.exp:
any_method( EXPORTING iv_param1 = lv_value1
                IMPORTING ev_param2 = lv_param2 ) ##NEEDED. " comment

cases.name: testPragmaAndConflictingComments
cases.exp:
any_method( EXPORTING iv_param1 = lv_value1
                IMPORTING ev_param2 = lv_param2 ) ##NEEDED. " comment; conflicting comment
